marketing_description: The DeWALT DW08802CG Cross Line Laser Level features a self-leveling design and green laser projection for visibility. This cordless tool has a working range with detector of 55 ft and an accuracy of 1/4 in at 30 ft, and includes features such as a locking pendulum and overmold housing for drop protection. The level also has a magnetic bracket and hang hole for various mounting options and a 1/4 thread for tripod attachment.
